notes: Pipeline-equivalent FPS = 1000 / median GPU ms of the synthetic neural pipeline; not game FPS, not DLSS.
median/p95_gpu_ms: pipelined timing. Frames are enqueued in batches of 32 without host waits; one CUDA event pair brackets each frame pipeline, so the value is device execution time.
latency_*: one event pair per frame after a host wait, so host launch overhead is visible. CUDA Graph replay targets this regime.
Modes are interleaved in rotating order at identical frame IDs. JIT is warmed first; a JIT during measurement aborts the run.
The residual network is not implemented. There is no NARC mode; CACHE_ONLY, CACHE_INTERP and CACHE_GRAPH are pure cache paths.
cache_hit_rate: fraction of samples served from a valid cache namespace. The dense cache is exhaustive over the scene domain, so it is 1.0 by construction and says nothing about quality.
temporal_key_reuse: fraction of samples whose nearest cache key equals the previous frame key. This measures actual reuse under camera/light motion.
Quality: MSE, RMSE, PSNR (peak 1.0) and max abs error of RGB against FULL, accumulated over every measured frame ID. PSNR null means identical images.
measured_vram_bytes: device free-memory delta from before allocation to ready-to-measure, including allocator reservation.
cold_compile_ms: runtime kernel JIT wall time in this process; bake_ms includes bake kernel JIT.
